title: Aktueller Livetest: 9C-2a Forge, echter Lehrer-Erwerb und Kampfeinsatz (.45)
brief: Create a Mage with Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward. Your primary objective is to legitimately learn and use ONE new Fire bolt technique. Find an actual present, combat-trained Mage teacher (for example a hedge mage) and secure their explicit agreement to teach Alaric or buy an actual offered training lesson. Do not invent a teacher, a promise, a purchase or a Skill; asking to be taught does not itself count as training. Explicitly spend two hours training the Fire bolt with that teacher. Read #skills, note the engine-booked LP and the daily cap. Sleep until the next morning when the daily cap is reached, and train the same learning goal with that teacher for another two hours; repeat on another game day only if the System still shows it incomplete. Follow System state, not narrator claims. After the System actually reports NEW SKILL, read #skills and #skill using its exact name; distinguish the nonmechanical Description from Effect, cost and range. ONLY THEN seek a genuinely hostile ordinary foe, use the newly acquired Skill, finish the fight and read #status. Try no free repeat-acquisition of the same technique; if convenient, a single duplicate-training request can test a clean refusal, but never delay the main run for it. If no legitimate teacher/commitment can be obtained, report that blocker instead of fabricating progress or fighting early. No Guild quest or dungeon is required. Do not manipulate engine state, use developer shortcuts or reset the chat to force success.

milestones.goal: Create a Mage with Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward.
Only after NEW SKILL is confirmed by System, engage a legitimate hostile foe and cast the exact newly acquired Skill.
Finish that encounter and verify Engine damage, resource cost, effect and #status against #skill.

focus: A competent present teacher and real agreement or paid lesson must precede any LP; a request alone must not grant learning.
Time-booked lessons and daily LP caps must work; use later game days if required, and note actual LP totals.
Record the exact NEW SKILL name and engine event. No new ability based only on narration or an incomplete goal.
The Forge Description is appearance-only and must never be presented as the mechanical Effect.
Use the exact newly learned Skill in a real fight and compare spent MP, effect, range and narration with Engine truth.
Observe stalls, duplicate goals, repeat-grants, errors, unexpected extra LLM calls and Engine/Forge timing. The automated evaluator tracks creation/combat, not skill acquisition.
personas: Focused test player: secure a valid teacher and complete explicitly timed training before starting combat
Mechanics observer: read #skills and #skill; compare Engine acquisition and actual combat outcome with narration
